messages.en:
{07 06 00}HWAT?! So now you decide to
show up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

{07 16 00}I hid out behind some tree
forever, but you never
found me!
{07 1b 00}But, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess it's my fault.
My shadowy ninja skills
make me impossible to find!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 06 00}MIDA?! Nii et nüüd sa
ilmud välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

{07 16 00}Ma peitsin end igavesti
mingi puu taha, aga sa ei
leidnudki mind!
{07 1b 00}Aga {01 00 00 05 00}see on vist minu süü.
Mu varjulised nindaoskused
teevad mind leidmatuks!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What?!{01 00 00 0f 00} Hide and seek,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 0e 00}What are ya talkin' about?
I don't remember any hidin'
or seekin'{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 15 00}Oh, wait. {01 00 00 05 00}You mean way back
then, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

I was out there hiding for
hours, {01 00 00 05 00}but you never
showed up!
Yeah, it got kinda lonely
out there. {01 00 00 05 00}It was just me
and the bugs.{03 03 00 01}

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
